nodes.label: Headless Claude integration
nodes.rationale: Turns norn from a launcher into an orchestrator: drive claude -p non-interactively and render results inline without opening a session. --bare skips hook/skill/MCP/CLAUDE.md discovery for deterministic machine-identical runs, with context passed explicitly.

nodes.label: internal/claude Run + Options design
nodes.rationale: Shells out with cmd.Dir = dir and parses the JSON envelope; driven from the TUI as a tea.Cmd goroutine so the event loop never blocks, with context.WithTimeout because headless can be slow even with --bare.

nodes.label: Dashboard session summarize (MVP use case)
nodes.rationale: Chosen as the first headless use case because it is read-only and low risk while still proving the integration end to end.

nodes.label: Headless cost and permission gates
nodes.rationale: Surface .total_cost_usd per call since headless/SDK calls may bill from a separate credit pool; keep --allowedTools minimal to read + git-read so no prompts appear, and never use --dangerously-skip-permissions.

nodes.label: PR review-since-stamp diff
nodes.rationale: Diffing reviewSHA..HEAD in the existing unified viewer makes the old side the code as reviewed and the added lines the fix, so comment and new code sit in one scroll. Side-by-side was rejected as an expensive two-column rewrite that is not the actual win.

nodes.label: GitHub outdated-comment limitation
nodes.rationale: GitHub drops a reviewer's comment from the Files-changed diff once the author edits that line, so comment and new code cannot be seen together even across all commits. Confirmed limitation, community thread #23138.

nodes.label: Review-stamp SHA resolution via gh api
nodes.rationale: Latest own review by submitted_at gives .commit_id as BASE; two-dot equals three-dot because HEAD descends from it. Fallbacks: no own review falls back to base...HEAD with a note, null original_line falls back to original_position, and comments outside the diff surface in a tail so nothing is hidden.

nodes.label: Local code review (shipped)
nodes.rationale: Comment any local diff with conventional-comment labels; R writes .norn/review.md and resumes the agent against it, so no PR and no public repo are required.

nodes.label: Rebrand work to norn
nodes.rationale: Module, GitHub repo, Nord theme, "many threads, one tree" identity, MIT license and README all moved together.

nodes.label: Public launch v0.1.0
nodes.rationale: VHS demo GIF plus a leaner README, Homebrew cask and tag-triggered release workflow, public repo and tap.

nodes.label: Multi-agent teams deliberately out of scope
nodes.rationale: Agent teams, peer-to-peer agent messaging and shared task lists with auto-dependency resolution target teams of agents coordinating on one feature, which is over-engineering for a solo one-agent-per-worktree setup. Revisit only at 5+ parallel agents on a single feature.

nodes.label: Backlog as GitHub Issues and Milestones
nodes.rationale: Live backlog moved out of the markdown file into Issues grouped by area/* labels, with a milestone per release, so the roadmap file keeps only shipped items and design write-ups.
